Fixed. The root cause: pi-subagents renamed its RPC `spawn` parameter — `workflowScript` was removed and inline scripts must now be passed as `script` (see the guard in `pi-subagents/src/extension/rpc.js:380`).

Changes:

- `extensions/factory/index.ts:130` — `spawnWorkflow` now sends `script` instead of `workflowScript` in the spawn RPC params.
- `tests/factory/rpc.test.ts` — updated the spawn smoke test to the new `script` param name.
- `tests/factory/helpers.ts` — added `piSubagentsImport()` which resolves `.ts` → compiled `.js`, since the installed pi-subagents no longer ships TS sources, and made the package-local `node_modules` symlink step tolerate its absence.
- `tests/factory/validator.test.ts`, `extensions/factory/README.md` — updated to match.

`npm test` passes: 175 passed, 0 failed (1 opt-in integration smoke skipped, as designed). `/factory` should start now.
